title: ITU Technologized: Shaping Digital Future With Global Cooperation
discussion_signal: The discussion treats resilient digital infrastructure, spectrum coordination, affordability, infrastructure gaps, regulatory alignment, and international cooperation as linked conditions for a safe digital future.
linked_research_question: How should societies govern cross-border digital dependencies when system failure can cascade and analogue fallback, shared warning, and coordination become public necessities?
limits: The post discusses policy priorities and does not document a specific system failure
It does not provide failure probabilities or resilience outcomes
Institutional framing may understate conflicts over sovereignty, cost, and accountability
